about: The mutation sweep's own corpus: `go run ./tools/mutation corpus` copies this directory, runs the real sweep with the real shell over each stage below, and fails unless every mutant gets the outcome named here and every refused stage is refused for the reason named here. Each finding's case sits beside a control that was right before the fix.

mutants.case: control: TestSum runs and its assertion fails
control: the same sum, TestSum runs and passes
control: Go's compiler refuses the mutant
F-051: TestSum skips under the mutant and go test still prints ok; it was a survivor
F-227: go test's own -timeout fires before the sweep's bound; it was a kill
F-051: the stage filters out every test and go test prints ok [no tests to run]; the sweep called the mutant a survivor and must refuse the stage
control: sum's TestSum runs and its assertion fails
F-051: sum's TestSum skips and other's TestSum, the same name, runs instead; counted by name alone it was a survivor

stages.name: proof-is-its-command
stages.refused: met by its own command line

mutants.case: F-051: a stage that runs nothing and whose proof is its own name, as an empty make recipe whose target the proof names; the sweep called the mutant a survivor and must refuse the stage

stages.name: native-spaced-path
stages.sh: mkdir -p build && cp native/sum.c 'build/sum spaced.c' && ${CC:-cc} -std=c11 -o build/sum 'build/sum spaced.c' && ./build/sum

mutants.case: control: the compiled program runs and its check fails
F-226: the C compiler refuses the mutant in a source whose path holds a space; it was a kill
control: the compiled program runs and its check fails
control: the same sum, the program runs and passes
F-226: the C compiler refuses the mutant before the program runs; it was a kill
F-051: the stage exits green without its proof under the mutant; it was a survivor
